label: 0022 · Smoothed in time (one QP over all windows): linked coupling + afterslip states, celeri's noise model, Boso SSEs removed, UNR positions (MAP)
description: One QP over all 25 windows of the Boso pilot (0021 with the Boso SSEs removed): background coupling linked through the whole record (departures of 0.1 over 5 yr, never reset) plus afterslip states for Tohoku (trench and BEL), the 2005 and 2021 Miyagi-oki, Noto and Hyuga-nada earthquakes. celeri's noise model (one σ per window, Student-t), so it fits like celeri and lets some window-specific signal into coupling. MAP solution, no posterior SD.
attribution: GNSS: GEONET daily positions, Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (GSI).
Coastline: Global Map Japan, Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (地球地図日本・国土地理院).
Earthquakes: Global CMT catalog (Dziewonski et al., 1981; Ekström et al., 2012).
